test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence.

She bought a _______ of shoes for the party.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pair**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**pair**" refers to a set of two related items or objects that are used together.
 
• In the context of shoes, a "**pair**" is the correct term, as shoes come in two pieces (left and right).
